title: P pixel chain (rounds 2-5): one material/ID-driven chain for the whole figure (face included), limb-audit gate, smears, 8 directions, GIF writer
question: Owner, round 1: 'limbs like legs sometimes flicker and disappear ... I still see disconnected parts like legs, thighs.' Can the 3D->pixel step keep legs from vanishing, separate overlapping legs, connect the thighs to the skirt (skin band + red sock top), and stay frame-to-frame stable (pxeval boil <= .02, shade_swap <= .015, no FEET_JITTER)?
method: render/pixel_chain.py (replaces E2 k-centroid -> palette lock -> fix): per-cell vote over matid x part (part = dominant deform bone from my extra pass render/p_parts.py, run through R's render_motion.py), outline drawn outside an eroded fill, legs/hands guaranteed >= 2 px (skeleton cells + 2x2 growth), 1 px far-side K line between leg.L|leg.R and arm|body overlaps (near side if the far limb would thin), 2-value skirt, red sock-top row guaranteed, near-leg d stripe + g rim, far leg one step darker; head from R's projected-master tex pass (texel-phase aligned). Temporal: exact surface correspondence from a rest-position pass -> hysteresis on fill/label/band, surface-locked shades, head hold, 1-frame flip removal, loops run twice. render/p2_run.sh runs passes + parts + chain + a round-1-chain baseline on the same passes.
result: ROUND 5 (out/p5, R's 23:16 WIP 3D face): head/face special cases removed (no tex projection, head hold, stamp, face layer); face matids from rig/face_mats.json are ordinary materials with thin-feature protection (iris 2x2 core; lash/brow/mouth presence). pxeval: walk SE boil .020 / shade_swap .026 (was .016/.038 with the projected head); idle SE/E/S boil .014-.017, swap .016-.020; run/jump/hurt boil .03-.15. Limb audit 11/18 clips pass (S-view leg SPLIT/DETACHED; no VANISHED). GIF check 18/18; whole experiment 1212 GIFs, 0 flags. ROUND 3-4: limb audit gate (VANISHED/SPLIT/THIN/DETACHED per leg/arm/hand), A-line/hem/skin-band/toe shape fixes, gifio writer (loop 0, >=20 ms, centisecond error diffusion, disposal 2), gifcheck, dash smear frames (afterimages + speed lines), 8 directions (archived projected-face build out/p3, 6 actions x 8). ROUND 2: pxeval (same passes; round-1 chain -> P2): walk SE boil .021->.016, shade_swap .029->.038 (P2 rig-head variant .024); walk S boil .023->.015, swap .036->.027, feet 9->2; idle SE/E/S boil .011->.007/.008/.006, swap .025-.027->.027/.026/.017; run and jump still boil .03-.13 (limb motion > 2 px/frame). Round 1 as shipped (walk SE, stamp): boil .056, swap .047. No FROZEN/STIFF (articulation 2.5-4.5/s walk/run, ~1/s idle). 74% of walk SE shade swaps sit on surfaces moving > 2.5 px/frame (dark keys K/D/h/H/d all within dE 12); the tex head adds ~.01 swap when the head rotates. FEET_JITTER in SE/E is real 30-degree stride perspective (~7 px); the SE walk forward sole clips 1 row at the cell bottom.
verdict: Round 5 pipeline is in; face reads from the 3D render in S/SE. Needs a re-run on R's final round-5 head + F's textures (iris colour ramp), and the S-view tucked-leg splits flagged by the audit. Round 2: Opus 6.5 vs 4.5, Argon 7.2 vs 3.4.
